summary: Shareable KB with vectors: snapshot export/import that skips re-embedding

comments.body: [devin] PR #73 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/73 — export-snapshot --with-vectors writes kb-snapshot-vectors.jsonl.gz (per-chunk pgvector text keyed by content_sha256); manifest records {model, dim, sha256}; import loads vectors when model matches, refuses mismatch/missing/corrupt loudly, leak guard unchanged, text-only still re-embeds. Vectors file gitignored, shared out-of-band. 5 unit tests green. Caveat for SETUP: query embedding still needs the gateway.
